ai-mistakes | chain:QI-40-1:1 | models.py, tests/test_models.py | NEW files models.py and tests/test_models.py. models.py docstring: Pip's tiny models, real and run by the game; nearest is a three-nearest-neighbour vote on whole-number features (distance = sum of differences; distance ties go to the earlier example; a three-way vote tie goes to the nearest example's label); confidence is the vote share as a whole percent; a pile is a list of {"x": [numbers], "label": word}. K = 3. `def distance(a, b): return sum(abs(p - q) for p, q in zip(a, b))`. `def neighbours(pile, x)`: sorted(range(len(pile)), key=lambda i: (distance(pile[i]["x"], x), i))[:K]. `def nearest(pile, x)`: near = neighbours(...); count votes per label; best = the top count; winners = [pile[i]["label"] for i in near if votes[that label] == best]; return (winners[0], best * 100 // len(near), near). MODELS = {"nearest": nearest}. `def guess(case, pile=None)`: label, confidence, _ = MODELS[case["model"]](case["pile"] if pile is None else pile, case["input"]); return (label, confidence). binary-bakery | chain:QI-37-1:1 | bits.py, tests/test_bits.py | NEW file bits.py and NEW file tests/test_bits.py. bits.py (docstring: a row is a list of 0/1; index i is the tray of 2**i buns, index 0 is the 1-bun tray) holds exactly these functions: `def tray_values(n): return [2 ** i for i in range(n)]`; `def count(row): return sum(2 ** i for i, bit in enumerate(row) if bit)`; `def row_for(value, n):` raise ValueError("%d does not fit in %d trays" % (value, n)) unless 0 <= value < 2 ** n, else `return [(value >> i) & 1 for i in range(n)]`; `def to_string(row): return "".join(str(bit) for bit in reversed(row))`; `def from_string(text): return [int(ch) for ch in reversed(text)]`; `def flips(a, b): return sum(1 for x, y in zip(a, b) if x != y)`. No other imports. tests/test_bits.py (import pytest and `from bits import count, flips, from_string, row_for, to_string, tray_values`): tray_values(4) == [1, 2, 4, 8]; count([1, 0, 1, 1]) == 13 and count([0, 0, 0, 0]) == 0; row_for(13, 4) == [1, 0, 1, 1]; to_string(row_for(13, 4)) == "1101" == format(13, "04b"); from_string("101101") == [1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1]; for value in range(64): count(row_for(value, 6)) == value; pytest.raises(ValueError) for row_for(16, 4) and for row_for(-1, 4); flips([1, 0, 1, 1], [0, 0, 1, 0]) == 2. Never change an expected value to make a test pass: fix the code.

Order dict: id, kind, trays, customer, line, answer (bit strings as to_string writes them), plus target (exact, add, broken), targets [a, b] (batch) or stuck [[index, value], ...] (broken). orders.py: `from bits import count, from_string`; KINDS = ("exact", "batch", "add", "broken"), TRAY_SIZES = (4, 6, 8, 10, 12); `def rows_needed(order): return 2 if order["kind"] in ("batch", "add") else 1`; `def served(order, rows)`: False unless len(rows) == rows_needed(order) and each row is trays long, all 0/1; exact: count(rows[0]) == target; broken: all(rows[0][i] == v for i, v in stuck) and count == target; batch: [count(rows[0]), count(rows[1])] == list(targets); add: count(rows[0]) + count(rows[1]) == target. `def problems(order)` -> list of strings: ["unknown kind %r" % kind] at once for a bad kind; "trays must be one of (4, 6, 8, 10, 12)"; "two-row orders use at most 8 trays" (if trays > 8); "needs a customer and a line"; and only if nothing else is wrong "the stored answer does not serve the order" when served(order, [from_string(s) for s in answer]) is False. circuit-playground | chain:QI-39-1:1 | solver.py, tests/test_solver.py | NEW files solver.py and tests/test_solver.py. Docstring: modified nodal analysis, exact with Fractions; a board is a list of parts {"id", "kind", "a", "b", "value"} (a and b are node names, "gnd" is ground; value is text: ohms for resistor and lamp, volts for battery, "closed" or "open" for switch, farads for capacitor, unused for wire, diode and led); a battery's a end is +; a diode or LED conducts from a to b. `from fractions import Fraction`, `from itertools import product`. DROPS = {"diode": Fraction(7, 10), "led": Fraction(2)}. `def _components(board)`: join a and b of every part except an open switch (but every node appears); return the connected groups as sets, built by going through the node names in sorted order and skipping nodes already placed. `def _gauss(matrix, rhs)`: exact Gauss-Jordan elimination with row swaps; None when a column has no non-zero pivot. Tests: P(pid, kind, a, b, value=None) helper returning the dict; OHM = [P("bat", "battery", "n1", "gnd", "9"), P("r1", "resistor", "n1", "n2", "100"), P("lamp", "lamp", "n2", "gnd", "200")]; _components(OHM + [P("x", "resistor", "p", "q", "5"), P("s", "switch", "q", "z", "open")]) == [{"gnd", "n1", "n2"}, {"p", "q"}, {"z"}]; _gauss([[Fraction(2), Fraction(1)], [Fraction(1), Fraction(3)]], [Fraction(5), Fraction(10)]) == [Fraction(1), Fraction(3)]; _gauss([[Fraction(1), Fraction(1)], [Fraction(2), Fraction(2)]], [Fraction(1), Fraction(2)]) is None.

# Drafted 2026-10-22 for LA-14 (first milestone of an unbuilt game), game: derelict-garden. # replaces: QI-15-1
fog-rescue | chain:QI-15-1:1 | wood.py, tests/test_rules.py | NEW files wood.py and tests/test_rules.py. wood.py docstring: rows are strings, '#' a tree (blocks), '.' a path tile, 'L' a lantern, 'F' the lantern holding the flame at the start, 'C' the cabin (also a lantern); a position is (x, y), y counted from the top. STEPS = ((0, -1), (1, 0), (0, 1), (-1, 0)) (up, right, down, left: the order every tie is broken in). class Wood: __init__(self, spec) sets id, name, rows, reach, glow from spec, self.par = spec.get("par"), self.line = [tuple(p) for p in spec.get("line", [])], self.creatures = [(kind, (x, y)) for kind, x, y in spec["creatures"]], self.h = len(rows), self.w = len(rows[0]), self.lanterns = every (x, y) whose char is in "LFC" in reading order (row by row), self.start = the F position, self.cabin = the C position. open(pos): inside the grid and not "#". neighbours(pos): [(x + dx, y + dy) for dx, dy in STEPS if open]. distances(source): breadth-first path distance from source to every tile it can reach, as a dict {pos: steps}, source 0. tests/test_rules.py: SPEC = {"id": "t", "name": "t", "rows": ["F...L", "#.#..", "C...."], "reach": 4, "glow": 4, "creatures": [["fawn", 4, 2], ["traveller", 1, 1]]}; w = Wood(SPEC): w.lanterns == [(0, 0), (4, 0), (0, 2)], w.start == (0, 0), w.cabin == (0, 2); w.neighbours((1, 1)) == [(1, 0), (1, 2)]; w.distances((0, 0))[(4, 2)] == 6 and w.distances((0, 0))[(0, 2)] == 4.
fog-rescue | chain:QI-15-1:2 | wood.py, rules.py, tests/test_rules.py | NEW file rules.py (wood.py and tests/test_rules.py are the NEW files from step 1; add tests, keep SPEC). A state is (flame, creatures), creatures a tuple of (kind, pos) in the wood's order. WALK = {"fawn": None, "traveller": 3} (steps walked toward a lantern it sees; None: all the way). start_state(wood): (wood.start, tuple(wood.creatures)). can_light(wood, state, lantern): False if lantern == state[0] or not in wood.lanterns, else wood.distances(state[0]).get(lantern, 99) <= wood.reach. walk(wood, kind, pos, lantern, dist): return pos if pos == wood.cabin or dist.get(pos, 99) > wood.glow; else taken = 0, while pos != lantern and (WALK[kind] is None or taken < WALK[kind]): pos = the first neighbour n of pos with dist.get(n, 99) == dist[pos] - 1, taken += 1, break if pos == wood.cabin (it settles there for good). light(wood, state, lantern): None unless can_light; dist = wood.distances(lantern); return (lantern, tuple((kind, walk(wood, kind, pos, lantern, dist)) for kind, pos in state[1])). Tests, w = Wood(SPEC), s = start_state(w): can_light(w, s, (4, 0)) and can_light(w, s, (0, 2)) True, (0, 0) False; Wood(dict(SPEC, reach=3)) cannot light (4, 0); light(w, s, (4, 0)) == ((4, 0), (("fawn", (4, 0)), ("traveller", (3, 0)))); with Wood(dict(SPEC, glow=2)) the same light gives ((4, 0), (("fawn", (4, 0)), ("traveller", (1, 1)))); light(w, light(w, s, (4, 0)), (0, 2)) is None (out of reach).

# replaces: QI-23-1
glitch-hunter | chain:QI-23-1:1 | room.py, tests/test_room.py | NEW files room.py and tests/test_room.py. Docstring: a room is a dict: id, name, rows (strings: "#" wall, "." floor, "D" a closed door, "K" a key on the floor, "P" the start, "E" the exit), rules, quirks, glitches ({rule id: par moves}), exit_par, note. A state is a tuple (pos, carry, floor, opened, slot_free, spent): pos (x, y); carry a tuple of items; floor a frozenset of (pos, item); opened a frozenset of door positions; slot_free True when the carry slot reads empty; spent how many keys were used up. Moves: "U", "D", "L", "R", "take", "drop"; two hands, never more than two things. RULES = {"carry-one": "You carry one thing at a time.", "doors": "A door opens only for someone carrying a key.", "key-once": "A key opens one door, then it is used up."}; QUIRKS = {"double-apply": "Opening a door does not use up the key.", "off-by-one": "The door check also counts a key lying next to the door.", "sticky-slot": "Dropping a thing leaves it in your hands as well."}; MOVES = {"U": (0, -1), "D": (0, 1), "L": (-1, 0), "R": (1, 0)}. `def start(room)`: pos = the "P" cell; floor = {((x, y), "key")} for every "K"; return (pos, (), frozenset(floor), frozenset(), True, 0). `def tile(room, pos)`: rows[y][x]. `def keys_in(room)`: how many "K" in the rows. Test: R = {"id": "t", "rows": ["######", "#P..K#", "####D#", "#E...#", "######"], "quirks": ["off-by-one"]}: start(R) == ((1, 1), (), frozenset({((4, 1), "key")}), frozenset(), True, 0); tile(R, (4, 2)) == "D"; keys_in(R) == 1.

At the end of grid_views.py add BENCH_OHMS_PER_KM = 0.05 and line_loss(voltage_kv, current_a, distance_km) returning {"sent_mw", "loss_mw", "percent"}: if voltage_kv <= 0 or current_a <= 0 all three are 0.0; else sent_mw = voltage_kv * current_a / 1000, loss_mw = current_a ** 2 * BENCH_OHMS_PER_KM * max(0, distance_km) / 1e6, percent = loss_mw / sent_mw * 100. housing-board | chain:QI-20-1:4 | board.py, tests/test_board.py | NEW file board.py (cast.py and tests/test_board.py are the NEW files from steps 1-3). last-line | chain:LL-M1:1 | tests/conftest.py, maze.py, tests/test_maze.py | NEW files maze.py and tests/test_maze.py. tests/conftest.py: in the for loop, change (GAME_DIR, GAME_DIR / "tools") to (GAME_DIR, GAME_DIR / "tools", GAME_DIR.parent.parent / "shared") so `import seed` (the shared seed module) works. maze.py docstring: the seeded maze generator; a maze is a dict: size (odd), seed, rows (strings: "#" hedge, "." open path, "T" the tower chamber, "G" a gate on the edge, "P" a stone pad beside a path; pads do not block the path), gates (list of (x, y)), pads (list of (x, y)). `import seed as seed_lib`; STEPS = ((0, -1), (1, 0), (0, 1), (-1, 0)); OPEN = ".TG". `def carve(rng, size)`: grid = size x size lists of "#"; grid[1][1] = "."; stack = [(1, 1)]; while stack: x, y = stack[-1]; options = [(dx, dy) for dx, dy in STEPS if 0 < x + 2 * dx < size - 1 and 0 < y + 2 * dy < size - 1 and grid[y + 2 * dy][x + 2 * dx] == "#"]; if none: stack.pop() and continue; dx, dy = rng.choice(options); open grid[y + dy][x + dx] and grid[y + 2 * dy][x + 2 * dx]; push (x + 2 * dx, y + 2 * dy). Return grid. Tests: g = carve(seed.rng("LASTLINE-K7F2Q").fork("carve"), 21): sum(row.count(".") for row in g) == 199 (100 rooms and 99 links: a spanning tree) and "".join(g[1]) == "#.....#.............#".
last-line | chain:LL-M1:2 | maze.py, tests/test_maze.py | maze.py (NEW file from step 1): `def braid(rng, grid, fraction)`: for y in range(1, size - 1, 2), for x in range(1, size - 1, 2): open_sides = steps whose neighbour cell is "."; if exactly one and rng.random() < fraction: walls = steps whose neighbour is "#" and 0 < x + 2 * dx < size - 1 and 0 < y + 2 * dy < size - 1; if walls: open the neighbour of rng.choice(walls). `def _odd_near(mid): return mid if mid % 2 == 1 else mid - 1`. `def base_maze(seed_text, size=21, gates=2, pads=12, braid_fraction=0.5)`: ValueError("the maze size is an odd number of at least 11") if size is even or < 11; rng = seed_lib.rng(seed_text); grid = carve(rng.fork("carve"), size); braid(rng.fork("braid"), grid, braid_fraction); mid = size // 2; the 3 x 3 cells around (mid, mid) become "T"; sides = rng.fork("gates").shuffled(["north", "east", "south", "west"])[:gates]; north gate (_odd_near(mid), 0), south (_odd_near(mid), size - 1), west (0, _odd_near(mid)), east (size - 1, _odd_near(mid)), set to "G"; candidates = inner "#" cells (row by row) with a "." neighbour; pad_list = sorted(rng.fork("pads").sample(candidates, pads)), each set to "P". Return {"size", "seed", "rows" (joined), "gates", "pads"}. Keep the draw order and fork names. Tests: braid with fraction 1.0 on the step 1 grid (rng seed.rng("x")) leaves 209 open cells, with 0.0 still 199; M = base_maze("LASTLINE-K7F2Q"): M == base_maze("LASTLINE-K7F2Q"), M["gates"] == [(0, 9), (9, 20)], len(M["pads"]) == 12; ValueError for size=20.

ROUNDINGS = ("exact", "dp1", "up"). `def unit_of(text)`: out = {}, sign = 1; for token in text.replace("/", " / ").replace("*", " * ").split(): "/" sets sign = -1, "*" is skipped, "1" is skipped, any other token adds sign to out[token]; return the dict without zero entries. `def _combine(a, b, sign)`: a copy of a with sign * each exponent of b added, zero entries removed. Tests: unit_of("m/s") == {"m": 1, "s": -1}; unit_of("m*m") == {"m": 2}; unit_of("1") == {}; unit_of("bolt/panel") == {"bolt": 1, "panel": -1}.

radio-decode | chain:QI-11-1:1 | ciphers.py, tests/test_ciphers.py | NEW files ciphers.py and tests/test_ciphers.py (never name it codecs.py: that hides a Python module). ciphers.py docstring: every codec is a pair of pure functions; encode then decode gives the text back. A = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ". `def bits_encode(text): return " ".join(format(ord(ch), "08b") for ch in text)`; `def bits_decode(symbols): return "".join(chr(int(group, 2)) for group in symbols.split())`; `def hex_encode(text): return " ".join(format(ord(ch), "02X") for ch in text)`; `def hex_decode(symbols): return "".join(chr(int(group, 16)) for group in symbols.split())`. Tests: bits_encode("HI") == "01001000 01001001"; bits_decode("01001000 01001001") == "HI"; hex_encode("HI!") == "48 49 21"; hex_decode("48 49 21") == "HI!".
radio-decode | chain:QI-11-1:2 | ciphers.py, tests/test_ciphers.py | ciphers.py (the NEW file from step 1): add the letter ciphers; each leaves any character not in A as it is. `def shift(text, n)`: each letter in A becomes A[(A.index(ch) + n) % 26]. `def mirror(text)`: A[25 - A.index(ch)]. `def reverse_words(text): return " ".join(word[::-1] for word in text.split(" "))`. `def keyword(text, key, sign=1)` (Vigenere): k = 0; each letter becomes A[(A.index(ch) + sign * A.index(key[k % len(key)])) % 26] and then k += 1; other characters are kept and do not use up the key; sign -1 decodes. Rail fence on two rails: `def rail_encode(text): return text[0::2] + text[1::2]`; `def rail_decode(symbols)`: half = (len(symbols) + 1) // 2; top, bottom = symbols[:half], symbols[half:]; return "".join(top[i // 2] if i % 2 == 0 else bottom[i // 2] for i in range(len(symbols))). Add tests to tests/test_ciphers.py (NEW file from step 1): shift("ABZ, Y", 2) == "CDB, A"; mirror("ABC Z") == "ZYX A"; reverse_words("COLD HARBOUR") == "DLOC RUOBRAH"; keyword("ATTACK AT", "LEMON") == "LXFOPV EF"; keyword("LXFOPV EF", "LEMON", -1) == "ATTACK AT"; rail_encode("ABCDEFG") == "ACEGBDF"; rail_decode("ACEGBDF") == "ABCDEFG"; rail_decode(rail_encode("ABCDEF")) == "ABCDEF". Never change an expected value to make a test pass: fix the code.

Docstring: a robot has n commands and n actions; inside, command i runs along hidden line scramble[i]; the patch bay the player sets sends line j to action patch[j]; so command i does actions[patch[scramble[i]]]; the start patch is [0, 1, ..., n - 1]. A robot is a dict: id, name, commands, actions, wanted (the wanted action name per command), scramble, story, gift, fix, par. wiring.py: `def plain_patch(n): return list(range(n))`; `def probe(robot, patch, command): return robot["actions"][patch[robot["scramble"][command]]]`; `def rig(robot, patch)`: one word per command, "Right" if probe(robot, patch, i) == robot["wanted"][i] else "Wrong" (do not name it test_rig: pytest would collect it as a test); `def fixed(robot, patch): return all(word == "Right" for word in rig(robot, patch))`. Tests: TOCK = {"id": "t", "name": "Tock", "commands": ["Wave", "Nod", "Beep"], "actions": ["wave arm", "nod head", "beep"], "wanted": ["wave arm", "nod head", "beep"], "scramble": [1, 2, 0]}; p = plain_patch(3) == [0, 1, 2]; [probe(TOCK, p, i) for i in range(3)] == ["nod head", "beep", "wave arm"]; rig(TOCK, p) == ["Wrong", "Wrong", "Wrong"]; fixed(TOCK, [0, 2, 1]) is False.

Milestone 1 holds the first two directories, /crew (12 files) and /log (18 files); run, send, scripts and forks come with milestone 3. Design choices made here: search takes only a tag word from a file already read, so hidden files are found by following clues; a locked file says which directory holds its code (no strict order); file text is a list of short lines; the content is plain Python modules (files_log.py, files_crew.py) joined in ship.py. Story choices (invented, gentle, nobody dies): a crew of six on the survey ship Anselm (Captain Mira Halloran, navigator Tobias Wren, medic Dr Ana Sefu, engineer Pell Ashdown, botanist and cook Juno Marsh, survey lead Ezra Vale); the flaws are the plan's (Wren hid the star tracker drift, Sefu copied the crew's letters out of worry, Halloran delayed the turn-back out of pride, told in a day-27 entry she hid); the crew left on the tender for the Brisk relay, their fate kept open for the endings; warm details (basil in a cupboard, a birthday cake, a dented harmonica). Engine only: no page, no game.py yet (milestone 2).

# Drafted 2026-10-22 for LA-14 (first milestone of an unbuilt game), game: three-sides-of-the-story. Every function, scene and expected value below was built and run in a scratch copy first (17 tests green). Milestone 1 is Ilse's view only: 14 scenes (two a day for seven days), 3 endings and the 4 fixed events she meets; Dev's and Rosa's views, the other fixed events and the Compare panel come with milestone 3, the Council with milestone 4. Design choices made here: stats start at Reservoir 31, Trust 0, Fairness 0 and change only through choices; buckets are high (30+), middle (27-29), low (26 and under); a choice may need a flag or a stat minimum/maximum; choices tagged harms mark where the viewpoint makes things worse for another view; the ledger keeps the first value of each fact and lists clashes; the reachability check is a breadth-first walk over (scene, stats, flags). Story choices (invented town and people, no villains, nobody harmed): Ilse's son Finn and her father Otto, her neighbour Hamid and his old well, Dev and Rosa as voices by text; her flaws are the plan's (the unpaid levy, night watering, passing on Rosa's rumour); the endings are Common Rows (sharing with Hamid), Young Trees (letting the old orchard rest) and Paid in Full (owning up); dry humour (rope and vinegar, the good boots). Engine only: no page, no game.py yet (milestone 2).

# Drafted 2026-10-22 for LA-14 (first milestone of an unbuilt game), game: undersleep. The folder is already scaffolded by scripts/new_game.py (CLAUDE.md, BUILD-STATUS.md, tests/__init__.py, tests/conftest.py that puts the game folder on sys.path, tools/). Every function, block and expected value below was built and run in a scratch copy first (21 tests green). Engine only: no page, no game.py yet (milestone 2); Rhythm stays at its start value 40 and chronotypes, entrainment and the amplitude link come with milestone 3, events and Rough Days with milestone 4. Design choices made here: a day is 96 quarter hours from midnight and a block may wrap past midnight; block effects are whole numbers per quarter hour; the curve is a game curve (a slow wave peaking at 11:00 plus a soft dip at 16:00-17:00), never a claim about real bodies; sleep debt is in hours (quarter steps), grows by the hours short of a 7.5-hour goal, shrinks twice as fast as it grows, is capped at 8 and lowers the energy ceiling by 5 per hour (never below 60); the only cost of low energy is half Output from work below 20 energy. Nothing is random, timed or lost. No milestone item exists for undersleep (Q-2 is all of Layer A), so the chain is named UN-M1 and replaces nothing.

# Drafted 2026-10-22 for LA-14 (first milestone of an unbuilt game), game: water-works. The folder is already scaffolded by scripts/new_game.py (CLAUDE.md, BUILD-STATUS.md, tests/__init__.py, tests/conftest.py that puts the game folder on sys.path, tools/). Every function, valley and expected value below was built and run in a scratch copy first (28 tests green). Chapter 1 (Teal Valley) has two voices, the town and the clerk, and channels only; the farm, wild and downstream voices, wells, reservoirs, filters and the Common ground label come with their chapters (milestones 3-4). Design choices made here: the flow rule works through nodes in their listed order (links only go forward), a dry year halves the source, and the clerk is Troubled only when a plan overspends (plans may overspend on paper). Engine only: no page, no game.py yet (milestone 2).

water-works | chain:QI-16-1:1 | flow.py, tests/test_flow.py | NEW files flow.py and tests/test_flow.py. Docstring: a valley is a dict: id, name, supply, budget, nodes ([id, kind, label] in flow order, source first), links ([id, from, to, cap, cost, built]; unbuilt ones can be bought), voices, plan, fair_plans. A plan is {"buy": [link ids], "shares": {fork node id: {link id: percent}}}, percents in steps of 10 adding to 100. flow.py: `def built_links(valley, plan)`: links with link[5] True or link[0] in plan["buy"]. `def flow(valley, plan, dry=False)`: arriving = {node id: 0}; carried = {}; links = built_links(...); for node_id, kind, _ in nodes in order: have = (supply // 2 if dry else supply) if kind == "source" else arriving[node_id]; outs = built links leaving the node; for each: pct = 100 if one out, else plan["shares"].get(node_id, {}).get(link id, 100 // len(outs)); amount = min(link[3], have * pct // 100); carried[link id] = amount; arriving[link[2]] += amount. Return (arriving, carried). Tests: V = {"id": "t", "name": "t", "supply": 40, "budget": 10, "nodes": [["spring", "source", "Spring"], ["town", "town", "Town"]], "links": [["old", "spring", "town", 10, 0, True], ["ditch", "spring", "town", 10, 6, False], ["pipe", "spring", "town", 30, 14, False]], "voices": {"town": {"need": 16}, "clerk": {}}}; NONE = {"buy": [], "shares": {}}: flow(V, NONE) == ({"spring": 0, "town": 10}, {"old": 10}) (a link never carries more than its cap).

water-works | chain:QI-16-1:3 | flow.py, voices.py, tests/test_flow.py | NEW file voices.py (flow.py and tests/test_flow.py are the NEW files from steps 1-2). `from flow import cost, flow`. RULES = {"town": "Content when the town gets its need even in a dry year; Wary when it gets it in a normal year only.", "clerk": "Content when the plan spends at most nine tenths of the budget; Wary when it spends at most all of it."}. `def town(valley, plan)`: need = valley["voices"]["town"]["need"]; node = the id of the node whose kind is "town"; dry arriving >= need -> ("Content", "Enough for every home, even in a dry year."); normal arriving >= need -> ("Wary", "Enough in a normal year, short in a dry one."); else ("Troubled", "Not enough water for the homes."). `def clerk(valley, plan)`: spent = cost(...); spent * 10 <= budget * 9 -> ("Content", "Within budget, with a tenth to spare."); spent <= budget -> ("Wary", "Within budget, but nothing to spare."); else ("Troubled", "Over budget."). JUDGES = {"town": town, "clerk": clerk}. `def verdicts(valley, plan)`: {name: judge(valley, plan) for name, judge in JUDGES.items() if name in valley["voices"]}. Tests (V, NONE, P, Q, R from steps 1-2): verdicts(V, P) == {"town": ("Content", "Enough for every home, even in a dry year."), "clerk": ("Content", "Within budget, with a tenth to spare.")}; verdicts(V, Q)["town"][0] == "Wary"; verdicts(V, R)["clerk"] == ("Troubled", "Over budget."); verdicts(V, NONE)["town"][0] == "Troubled".
water-works | chain:QI-16-1:4 | voices.py, plans.py, tests/test_flow.py | voices.py (NEW file from step 3): add `def outcome(valley, plan)`: "Fair share" if every verdict word is Content, "Settled" if none is Troubled, else "Unsettled". NEW file plans.py (the plan enumerator). `from itertools import combinations, product`, `from flow import built_links, cost`, `from voices import outcome`. `def splits(k)`: [s for s in product(range(0, 101, 10), repeat=k) if sum(s) == 100]. `def all_plans(valley)`: buyable = ids of links not built; for r in range(len(buyable) + 1), for buy in combinations(buyable, r): plan = {"buy": list(buy), "shares": {}}; forks = [(node id, [ids of its built out links])] for every node with more than one built out link, in node order; for choice in product(*[splits(len(outs)) for _, outs in forks]): append {"buy": list(buy), "shares": {fork: dict(zip(outs, pcts)) for (fork, outs), pcts in zip(forks, choice)}}. `def survey(valley)`: fair = [p for p in all_plans(valley) if outcome(valley, p) == "Fair share"]; return {"fair": fair, "cheapest": min cost over fair, None if empty}. Tests (V, NONE, P, Q, R from steps 1-2): [outcome(V, p) for p in (P, Q, R, NONE)] == ["Fair share", "Settled", "Unsettled", "Unsettled"]; len(splits(2)) == 11; len(splits(3)) == 66; len(all_plans(V)) == 89; s = survey(V): len(s["fair"]) == 5 and s["cheapest"] == 6.
